documents.notes: 'International Applicant Checklist' page. Optional InitialView/Vericant interviews are not a document. An English proficiency waiver request is possible at the Board of Admissions' discretion. The page's financial-document date example refers to Fall 2026 enrolment and the test-optional policy runs 'through fall 2028 and spring 2029'; the checklist itself states no academic year.

items.quote: As a first-year international student applicant, you must submit the following credentials: Common Application
Official copies of your secondary school transcripts must be submitted by a school official.
Please ask your counselor to submit the School Report form and the School Counselor Recommendation form found on the Common Application.
Please ask a teacher to submit the Teacher Evaluation form found on the Common Application.

If your first language is not English, you must take the Test of English as a Foreign Language Internet Based Test (TOEFL iBT), International English Language Testing System (IELTS), or the Duolingo English Test (DET).
items.condition: your first language is not English

items.quote: All students who will be studying on an F-1 Student Visa or J-1 Exchange Visitor Visa are required to submit financial documentation and we recommend submitting these items along with your application.
items.condition: the student will study on an F-1 Student Visa or J-1 Exchange Visitor Visa

items.quote: All international students must supply a photocopy of the photo/data page of their current, valid passport.
All documents written in a world language must be accompanied by a notarized English translation.
items.condition: a document is written in a language other than English (notarized English translation)

items.quote: Boston University is test optional for first-year applicants applying for admission through fall 2028 and spring 2029.
